body:
MAINLINE-015b checked independently. All 1,331 arithmetic/display/flag comparisons reproduce, covering every one of 1,201 owner RESULTS scalar leaves. Pins match. No owner code was read or run.

The live lambda-1 amplitude/width pair and nu 0.33 repair the principal 015 errors. Retired/live RMS is 2.611262732308197. The original continuous SF 1 threshold remains 0.5183040769297532; the first passing original grid level is 0.519.

At actual gammas, 021 amplitude/RMS are 11.8014082501/0.139344127347 mm; 021b values are 45.8194414540/0.654415969676 mm. Lee inverses and range flags reproduce.

COVERAGE answers all fourteen prior findings: three resolved in this map, five partly addressed, five outside-scope topics not revisited, and one validation finding acknowledged but open. Omitted legacy sections are not silently closed.

One prose correction: rounding 021b gamma to 0.468 changes amplitude by 0.173547284606 mm, or 0.378763422466%, affecting the third significant digit. The blanket fourth-digit claim is false. Both numeric rows are correct.

Two further qualifications: whole-sphere RMS uses a small-angle area approximation, overstating the widest P2-E k5 value by 0.628886203836%; Lee's k1–k5 span is a conditional geometric bound, not an iso-knockdown curve. Its Fig. 6(c) supplies critical-width information.

QUESTIONABLE remains. Eleven carried findings and three new qualifications are nonblocking. CHECK gives derivations, source limits and exact comparisons. No successor job is named.
